Package com.im.njams.sdk.model

Class ActivityMapping

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.im.njams.sdk.model.ActivityMapping
  • public final class ActivityMapping
extends Object
    Produces the tree-viewer JSON structure that the nJAMS UI renders for an activity mapping.

    The structure is a root object carrying a name and an entries array, where each entry is either a leaf (name + value) or a branch (name + nested entries). This class lets callers obtain that JSON without knowing the exact format or handling JSON serialization themselves.

    There are two ways to create an instance:

    • builder(String) — construct the tree programmatically, node by node, to arbitrary depth: 
       String json = ActivityMapping.builder("stylesheet")
     .leaf("version", "2.0")
     .branch("template", t -> t
         .leaf("match", "/")
         .branch("ActivityInput", a -> a.leaf("message", "...")))
     .toJson();
    • fromObject(String, Object) — derive the tree automatically from an arbitrary object: scalar properties become leaves, nested objects and collections become branches, recursively.

    Pass the result straight to ActivityModel.setMapping(ActivityMapping), or obtain the raw string via toJson() and use ActivityModel.setMapping(String).

    Author:
    cwinkler

    • Method Detail

      • builder

        public static ActivityMapping.Builder builder​(String rootName)
        Starts building a mapping tree programmatically. The returned builder represents the root branch with the given label; add leaves and branches to it and call ActivityMapping.Builder.build() to obtain the ActivityMapping.
        Parameters:
        rootName - label of the root node
        Returns:
        a new ActivityMapping.Builder

      • fromObject

        public static ActivityMapping fromObject​(String rootName,
                                         Object source)
        Derives a mapping tree from an arbitrary object, analogous to serializing it to JSON. Scalar values become leaf nodes (name + value), nested objects and collections become branch nodes (name + entries), recursively to arbitrary depth. Collection elements are named by their position ("0", "1", …). A null value yields a leaf with an empty-string value. If source itself is a scalar, it is wrapped as a single leaf so that the root remains a branch.
        Parameters:
        rootName - label of the root node
        source - the object to derive the tree from; may be null
        Returns:
        a new ActivityMapping

      • fromPlainJson

        public static ActivityMapping fromPlainJson​(String rootName,
                                            String json)
        Derives a mapping tree from an arbitrary JSON string. This behaves like fromObject(String, Object) with the object parsed from the given JSON: JSON objects become branch nodes, JSON arrays become branch nodes whose entries are named by their position ("0", "1", …), and scalar values become leaf nodes. A JSON null yields a leaf with an empty-string value. If the JSON is a scalar at the top level, it is wrapped as a single leaf so that the root remains a branch.
        Parameters:
        rootName - label of the root node
        json - the JSON string to derive the tree from
        Returns:
        a new ActivityMapping
        Throws:
        NjamsSdkRuntimeException - if the given string is not valid JSON
